feature_discovery_excluded_from_threshol.rule: v2.8 may justify the feature form A34 but no v2.8 value may determine the v2.9 numerical threshold

speculative_budget.precondition: before buying level1+2 require speculative_jvp_so_far + 80 <= 0.25 * committed_rjf_jvp_before_target
speculative_budget.postcondition: actual cumulative level1+2 JVP for the event must be <=80; otherwise hard fail
speculative_budget.audit_full_e_work: explicitly separate from runtime speculative budget and never used to mutate R-JF state/controller

audit_label.unsafe: full-E audit total_error is nonfinite or >1

threshold_selection.candidate_family: tau in unique finite calibration A34 values plus all-abstain sentinel
hard_filters: zero unsafe recommendations in every family x dimension group
Bonferroni zero-failure one-sided 95% upper unsafe-rate bound <=0.15 using M searched thresholds
threshold_selection.selection: among surviving candidates choose the one with largest recommended-event count; ties choose the smaller tau
threshold_selection.predeclared_shrink: freeze tau_final=0.95*tau_selected and recompute all hard filters; if any filter fails choose all-abstain

holdout_hard_gates: R-JF committed trace unchanged by audit shadows
groupwise family x dimension results reported before pooled results
forbidden: v2.8 gap used to choose tau
